entities.name: Besshatyr necropolis
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Besshatyr Kurgan in Kazakhstan is a complex of tombs of the Semirechye-Saka tribe era. From the Kazakh language, "Besshatyr" translates as "Five Tents" which is most likely derived from the number of the largest mounds in this area.
